summary: Plan to reconfigure the Leave Tracker application from private IP 10.172.19.16:80 to public IP 40.90.111.70:8086. Covers changes to server .env files (FRONTEND_URL, ALLOWED_ORIGINS), Nginx configs (server_name), health monitor defaults, deploy scripts, and documentation. Frontend code needs no changes due to dynamic API URL resolution. Includes open questions about port forwarding target, dual-access requirements, and email link behavior.
